_comment: Each step reveals `reveal` hidden glyphs (default 1), in the fixed order chosen by gen/generate.js.
deadline: relative to launch ('+36h', '+2d') or absolute ISO. Every hidden glyph is time-locked (drand tlock) to its step's deadline,
so the reveal happens AT THE LATEST at the deadline, even if the creator disappears. A milestone can only make a step happen EARLIER.
milestone.mcapUsd: market cap that must be held CONTINUOUSLY for milestoneRule.windowMinutes on >= minSources independent sources.
The sum of all `reveal` values must equal the number of hidden glyphs (startHidden).
